<!-- ============================================================
     BUILD 2036 — full hackathon page with capsule tabs
     ONE block for your CMS. Vanilla HTML + CSS only: no JS, no external links.

     How it works: the capsules are labels for hidden radio buttons.
     Clicking one selects it and CSS shows only that page. There are no links,
     so the page never reloads, the URL never changes, and it works with any
     CMS or single-page app (including ones with a <base href>).
     ============================================================ -->

<style>
  @property --b36-angle { syntax: "<angle>"; inherits: false; initial-value: 0deg; }

  /* ============================================================
     PAGE SHELL: capsule tabs that switch the content (no JS)
     Each tab is a plain link to #b36x-<page>. CSS shows only the
     targeted page; with no target, the Overview (About + Timeline) shows.
     ============================================================ */
  .b36x {
    --b36x-ink: #161a2e;
    --b36x-red: #c53030;
    --b36x-maroon: #8e1b1b;
    --b36x-ember: #f05a28;
    --b36x-line: #e7e8ec;
    --b36x-ease: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.75, 0.2, 1);
    position: relative;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
    -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; text-size-adjust: 100%;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }
  .b36x *, .b36x *::before, .b36x *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

  /* ---------- Content switch: a row of pill buttons inside the page ---------- */
  .b36x__bar { margin: 0 0 clamp(18px, 3vw, 28px); }
  .b36x__nav {
    display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin: -4px;
  }
  .b36x .b36x__tab {
    flex: none;
    margin: 4px;
    padding: 10px 20px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid var(--b36x-line);
    background: #fff;
    color: var(--b36x-ink);
    font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.2;
    white-space: nowrap;
    transition: color 0.3s, background 0.3s, border-color 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s, transform 0.3s var(--b36x-ease);
  }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .b36x .b36x__tab:hover { border-color: rgba(197, 48, 48, 0.45); color: var(--b36x-red); }
  }

  /* hidden radio buttons hold the selected tab (no links, so no reload or URL change).
     They sit right inside the tab row: the row is always on screen when a tab is
     clicked, so the browser never needs to scroll and the page stays exactly where it is. */
  .b36x__radio {
    position: absolute; top: 14px; left: 14px;
    width: 1px; height: 1px;
    margin: 0; padding: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .b36x .b36x__tab { cursor: pointer; -webkit-user-select: none; user-select: none; }

  /* active capsule */
  #b36x-r-overview:checked ~ .b36x__bar .b36x__tab--overview,
  #b36x-r-Problem Statements:checked ~ .b36x__bar .b36x__tab--Problem Statements:,
  #b36x-r-journey:checked ~ .b36x__bar .b36x__tab--journey,
  #b36x-r-prizes:checked ~ .b36x__bar .b36x__tab--prizes,
  #b36x-r-capsule:checked ~ .b36x__bar .b36x__tab--capsule,
  #b36x-r-faq:checked ~ .b36x__bar .b36x__tab--faq {
    color: #fff;
    border-color: transparent;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--b36x-red), var(--b36x-maroon));
    box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -10px rgba(197, 48, 48, 0.8);
  }
  /* keyboard focus (arrow keys move between capsules) */
  #b36x-r-overview:focus-visible ~ .b36x__bar .b36x__tab--overview,
  #b36x-r-frontiers:focus-visible ~ .b36x__bar .b36x__tab--frontiers,
  #b36x-r-journey:focus-visible ~ .b36x__bar .b36x__tab--journey,
  #b36x-r-prizes:focus-visible ~ .b36x__bar .b36x__tab--prizes,
  #b36x-r-capsule:focus-visible ~ .b36x__bar .b36x__tab--capsule,
  #b36x-r-faq:focus-visible ~ .b36x__bar .b36x__tab--faq { outline: 3px solid rgba(197, 48, 48, 0.45); outline-offset: 1px; }

  /* ---------- Pages: only the selected one is shown ---------- */
  .b36x__panel { display: none; }
  #b36x-r-overview:checked ~ .b36x__panels .b36x__panel--overview,
  #b36x-r-frontiers:checked ~ .b36x__panels .b36x__panel--frontiers,
  #b36x-r-journey:checked ~ .b36x__panels .b36x__panel--journey,
  #b36x-r-prizes:checked ~ .b36x__panels .b36x__panel--prizes,
  #b36x-r-capsule:checked ~ .b36x__panels .b36x__panel--capsule,
  #b36x-r-faq:checked ~ .b36x__panels .b36x__panel--faq {
    display: block;
    animation: b36x-in 0.5s var(--b36x-ease) both;
  }
  @keyframes b36x-in { from { -webkit-transform: translateY(14px); transform: translateY(14px); } to { -webkit-transform: none; transform: none; } }

  .b36x__gap { height: clamp(12px, 3vw, 32px); }

  /* About section: align to the CMS column like the other pages */
  .b36x .b36 { padding-top: clamp(4px, 1.5vw, 16px); padding-bottom: 0; }
  .b36x .b36__wrap { max-width: none; padding: 0; }

  /* phones: the pills simply wrap onto more lines */
  @media (max-width: 600px) {
    .b36x .b36x__tab { padding: 9px 15px; font-size: 0.9rem; }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .b36x__panel { animation: none !important; }
    .b36x .b36x__tab { transition: none; }
  }


  /* ============================== ABOUT ============================== */

  
  .b36 {
    --b36-ink: #161a2e;
    --b36-text: #474c5e;
    --b36-muted: #6b7080;
    --b36-red: #c53030;
    --b36-maroon: #8e1b1b;
    --b36-ember: #f05a28;
    --b36-flare: #ff3d7f;
    --b36-violet: #7a4dff;
    --b36-sky: #3fb8ff;
    --b36-line: #e7e8ec;
    --b36-tint: #fff5f2;
    --b36-ease: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.75, 0.2, 1);

    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    isolation: isolate;
    container: b36 / inline-size;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--b36-text);
    padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 72px) 0;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.6;
    -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
            text-size-adjust: 100%;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }
  .b36 *, .b36 *::before, .b36 *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
  .b36 h2, .b36 h3, .b36 p { margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  .b36 svg { max-width: none; }

  .b36__wrap { position: relative; max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 clamp(16px, 4vw, 40px); }

  /* stagger helpers (classes instead of inline styles, so CMS sanitisers can't strip them) */
  .b36-d1 { --i: 1; } .b36-d2 { --i: 2; } .b36-d3 { --i: 3; } .b36-d4 { --i: 4; }

  /* ---------- Ambient decoration (light) ---------- */
  .b36__dots {
    position: absolute; z-index: -1;
    top: -6%; left: -14%; width: 60%; height: 62%;
    background-image: radial-gradient(circle, var(--b36-ember) 1.2px, transparent 1.8px);
    background-size: 14px 14px;
    -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 45% at 35% 45%, #000 10%, transparent 72%);
            mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 45% at 35% 45%, #000 10%, transparent 72%);
    opacity: 0.28;
    transform: rotate(-18deg) skewX(-12deg);
    animation: b36-drift 8s linear infinite;
  }
  .b36__glowfield {
    position: absolute; z-index: -1;
    top: -18%; right: -22%; width: 70%; height: 75%;
    background:
      radial-gradient(closest-side at 40% 55%, rgba(240, 90, 40, 0.22), transparent),
      radial-gradient(closest-side at 65% 40%, rgba(255, 61, 127, 0.16), transparent),
      radial-gradient(closest-side at 75% 70%, rgba(122, 77, 255, 0.10), transparent);
    animation: b36-sway 12s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    will-change: transform;
  }
  .b36__ghost {
    position: absolute; z-index: -1;
    right: -3%; top: 0;
    font-size: clamp(8rem, 30vw, 26rem);
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: -0.06em;
    line-height: 0.8;
    color: transparent;
    -webkit-text-stroke: 1px rgba(197, 48, 48, 0.18);
    -webkit-user-select: none; user-select: none;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* ---------- Intro ---------- */
  .b36__intro {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.3fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: clamp(24px, 5vw, 72px);
    align-items: end;
  }
  .b36__title {
    font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 6.2vw, 5.25rem);
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.04em;
    color: var(--b36-ink);
  }
  .b36__title > span { display: block; }
  .b36__glow { color: var(--b36-red); }
  @supports ((-webkit-background-clip: text) or (background-clip: text)) {
    .b36 .b36__glow {
      background: linear-gradient(100deg, var(--b36-maroon) 0%, var(--b36-red) 25%, var(--b36-ember) 45%,
        var(--b36-flare) 60%, var(--b36-red) 80%, var(--b36-maroon) 100%);
      background-size: 250% 100%;
      -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text;
      color: transparent;
      animation: b36-shine 6s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
  }
  .b36__lede { border-left: 3px solid var(--b36-red); padding-left: 22px; max-width: 58ch; }
  .b36__lede p { font-size: 1.0625rem; }
  .b36__lede p + p { margin-top: 14px; }
  .b36__lede strong { color: var(--b36-ink); }

  /* ---------- Crossing marquee bands ---------- */
  .b36__bands { position: relative; height: clamp(64px, 7vw, 84px); margin: clamp(16px, 3vw, 36px) 0 clamp(4px, 1vw, 12px); }
  .b36__band { position: absolute; left: -5%; width: 110%; top: 50%; overflow: hidden; padding: 11px 0; }
  .b36__band--a {
    z-index: 2;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--b36-maroon), var(--b36-red) 30%, var(--b36-red) 70%, var(--b36-ember));
    -webkit-transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(-1.6deg); transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(-1.6deg);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -12px rgba(197, 48, 48, 0.5);
  }
  .b36__band--b {
    z-index: 1;
    background: #fff;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--b36-line);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--b36-line);
    -webkit-transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(1.4deg); transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(1.4deg);
  }
  .b36__track {
    display: flex; align-items: center;
    width: -webkit-max-content; width: max-content;
    white-space: nowrap;
    animation: b36-marquee 32s linear infinite;
    will-change: transform;
  }
  .b36__track > * { margin-right: 26px; flex: none; }
  .b36__band--b .b36__track { animation-direction: reverse; animation-duration: 40s; }
  .b36__track span { font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(0.95rem, 1.6vw, 1.25rem); color: #fff; }
  .b36__band--b .b36__track span {
    font-size: clamp(1.15rem, 2.2vw, 1.75rem); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    color: transparent; -webkit-text-stroke: 1px rgba(22, 26, 46, 0.6);
  }
  .b36__track svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: #fff; }
  .b36__band--b .b36__track svg { fill: var(--b36-ember); }

  /* ---------- Journey + prize ---------- */
  .b36__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: clamp(16px, 3vw, 32px); align-items: stretch; }

  .b36__journey {
    position: relative;
    border: 1px solid var(--b36-line);
    border-radius: 24px;
    padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 48px);
    background: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(22, 26, 46, 0.04), 0 18px 48px -24px rgba(22, 26, 46, 0.18);
  }
  .b36__h3 { font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 2.6vw, 2rem); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--b36-ink); }
  .b36__journey > p { max-width: 52ch; margin: 10px 0 32px; }

  .b36__path, .b36__steps { position: relative; }
  .b36__steps::before, .b36__steps::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 11px; top: 12px; bottom: 12px; width: 2px; }
  .b36__steps::before { background: var(--b36-line); }
  .b36__steps::after {
    background: linear-gradient(var(--b36-maroon), var(--b36-red) 50%, var(--b36-ember));
    -webkit-transform-origin: top; transform-origin: top;
    animation: b36-fill 1.6s var(--b36-ease) 0.6s both;
  }
  .b36__pulse {
    position: absolute; left: 8px; top: 12px; z-index: 3;
    width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--b36-ember);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(240, 90, 40, 0.2), 0 0 12px 2px rgba(240, 90, 40, 0.5);
    animation: b36-travel 3.4s ease-in-out 2.2s infinite;
  }
  .b36 .b36__step { position: relative; padding-left: 46px; transition: transform 0.35s var(--b36-ease); }
  .b36 .b36__step + .b36__step { margin-top: 26px; }
  .b36 .b36__step::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; left: 3px; top: 4px; z-index: 2;
    width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: #fff;
    border: 2px solid var(--b36-red);
    transition: background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;
  }
  .b36__steps > .b36__step:last-child::before {
    background: var(--b36-red); border-color: var(--b36-red);
    animation: b36-beacon 2.4s ease-out infinite;
  }
  .b36__step-name { display: block; font-weight: 700; color: var(--b36-ink); font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.4; transition: color 0.3s; }
  .b36__step-desc { display: block; color: var(--b36-muted); font-size: 0.97rem; }

  /* Prize card with rotating light border */
  .b36__prize {
    position: relative;
    border-radius: 24px;
    padding: 2px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--b36-red), var(--b36-ember), var(--b36-flare));
    background: conic-gradient(from var(--b36-angle), var(--b36-maroon), var(--b36-red), var(--b36-ember),
      var(--b36-flare), var(--b36-violet), var(--b36-sky), var(--b36-maroon));
    animation: b36-spin 7s linear infinite;
    box-shadow: 0 24px 60px -28px rgba(197, 48, 48, 0.55);
  }
  .b36__prize-in {
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 22px;
    background: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 100% 100%, rgba(240, 90, 40, 0.12), transparent 60%), var(--b36-tint);
    padding: clamp(22px, 4vw, 44px);
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between;
    container-type: inline-size;
  }
  .b36__prize-top { flex: 1 1 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; }
  .b36__prize-label { color: var(--b36-muted); font-size: 1rem; }
  .b36 .b36__amt {
    margin: 4px 0 20px;
    font-size: 3rem;
    font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 18cqi, 5.5rem);
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    line-height: 1.08;
    white-space: nowrap;
    color: var(--b36-red);
    animation: b36-wipe 1.2s var(--b36-ease) 0.5s both;
  }
  @supports ((-webkit-background-clip: text) or (background-clip: text)) {
    .b36 .b36__amt {
      background: linear-gradient(95deg, var(--b36-maroon), var(--b36-red) 40%, var(--b36-ember) 85%);
      -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text;
      color: transparent;
    }
  }
  .b36__facts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); border-top: 1px solid rgba(197, 48, 48, 0.18); padding-top: 18px; }
  .b36__facts p + p { border-left: 1px solid rgba(197, 48, 48, 0.18); padding-left: 18px; }
  .b36__facts strong { display: block; color: var(--b36-ink); font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.2; }
  .b36__facts span { display: block; color: var(--b36-muted); font-size: 0.92rem; }

  /* ---------- Highlights ---------- */
  .b36__hl { margin-top: 0; }
  .b36__hl .b36__h3 { margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .b36__tiles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 14px; }
  .b36 .b36__tile {
    position: relative; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate;
    margin: 0;
    min-height: 196px;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 22px 20px;
    border: 1px solid var(--b36-line);
    border-radius: 18px;
    background: #fff;
    color: var(--b36-ink); font-weight: 650; font-size: 1.02rem; line-height: 1.4;
    transition: transform 0.45s var(--b36-ease), border-color 0.45s, box-shadow 0.45s;
  }
  .b36__tile::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; left: -30%; right: -30%; bottom: -70%; height: 120%; z-index: -1;
    background: radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(240, 90, 40, 0.18), rgba(197, 48, 48, 0.08) 55%, transparent);
    opacity: 0; -webkit-transform: translateY(30%); transform: translateY(30%);
    transition: opacity 0.5s, transform 0.6s var(--b36-ease);
  }
  .b36 .b36__icon {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    width: 52px; height: 52px; margin-bottom: 24px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    background: var(--b36-tint);
  }
  .b36__tile svg {
    width: 28px; height: 28px;
    fill: none; stroke: var(--b36-red); stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round;
    transition: transform 0.5s var(--b36-ease);
  }
  .b36 .b36__tile--prize {
    background: linear-gradient(150deg, var(--b36-red), var(--b36-maroon));
    border-color: transparent; color: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -20px rgba(142, 27, 27, 0.7);
  }
  .b36__tile--prize .b36__icon { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); }
  .b36__tile--prize svg { stroke: #fff; }
  .b36__orbit { transform-box: fill-box; -webkit-transform-origin: center; transform-origin: center; animation: b36-orbit 12s linear infinite; }
  .b36__orbit circle { fill: var(--b36-ember); stroke: none; }

  /* Hover effects only on devices that really hover (avoids sticky states after a tap in web views) */
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .b36__band:hover .b36__track { animation-play-state: paused; }
    .b36__steps > .b36__step:hover { -webkit-transform: translateX(6px); transform: translateX(6px); }
    .b36__steps > .b36__step:hover::before { background: var(--b36-ember); border-color: var(--b36-ember); box-shadow: 0 0 14px 2px rgba(240, 90, 40, 0.45); }
    .b36__steps > .b36__step:hover .b36__step-name { color: var(--b36-red); }
    .b36__tile:hover { -webkit-transform: translateY(-6px); transform: translateY(-6px); border-color: rgba(197, 48, 48, 0.35); box-shadow: 0 20px 44px -22px rgba(197, 48, 48, 0.45); }
    .b36__tile:hover::before { opacity: 1; -webkit-transform: none; transform: none; }
    .b36__tile:hover svg { -webkit-transform: scale(1.12) rotate(-8deg); transform: scale(1.12) rotate(-8deg); }
    .b36__tile--prize:hover { border-color: transparent; }
  }

  /* ---------- Reveal ---------- */
  .b36-rise { animation: b36-rise 0.9s var(--b36-ease) calc(var(--i, 0) * 0.1s) both; }

  /* ---------- Keyframes ---------- */
  @keyframes b36-rise    { from { -webkit-transform: translateY(28px); transform: translateY(28px); } to { -webkit-transform: none; transform: none; } }
  @keyframes b36-drift   { to { background-position: 28px 14px; } }

    <div class="b36q__list">

      <details class="b36q__item" open>
        <summary class="b36q__q"><span class="b36q__num" aria-hidden="true">01</span><span class="b36q__text">What is BUILD 2036?</span><span class="b36q__icon" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
        <p class="b36q__a">BUILD 2036 is the official hackathon of the 11th TiE Global Summit 2026. It brings together developers, students and young founders to build working, AI-enabled solutions across six future-focused innovation tracks.</p>
      </details>

      <details class="b36q__item">
        <summary class="b36q__q"><span class="b36q__num" aria-hidden="true">02</span><span class="b36q__text">Who can participate?</span><span class="b36q__icon" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
        <p class="b36q__a">The programme is designed for developers, students and young founders. Detailed eligibility requirements will be shared in the official programme guidelines.</p>
      </details>

      <details class="b36q__item">
        <summary class="b36q__q"><span class="b36q__num" aria-hidden="true">03</span><span class="b36q__text">Is BUILD 2036 an online or offline hackathon?</span><span class="b36q__icon" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
        <p class="b36q__a">The hackathon begins online on the Hack2skill platform. The Top 10 finalist teams will advance to the in-person Grand Finale in Indore on <strong>14 December 2026</strong>.</p>
      </details>

      <details class="b36q__item">
        <summary class="b36q__q"><span class="b36q__num" aria-hidden="true">04</span><span class="b36q__text">What are the available innovation tracks?</span><span class="b36q__icon" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
        <p class="b36q__a">There are six tracks: Applied AI & Agentic Intelligence, Climate & Clean Energy, Digital Infrastructure, Manufacturing Renaissance, Health, Longevity & Biotechnology, and The Rise of New India.</p>
      </details>

      <details class="b36q__item">
        <summary class="b36q__q"><span class="b36q__num" aria-hidden="true">05</span><span class="b36q__text">Can I participate individually or do I need a team?</span><span class="b36q__icon" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
        <p class="b36q__a">Team size and team formation rules are yet to be confirmed. Please refer to the official programme guidelines once published.</p>
      </details>

      <details class="b36q__item">
        <summary class="b36q__q"><span class="b36q__num" aria-hidden="true">06</span><span class="b36q__text">What do participants need to submit?</span><span class="b36q__icon" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
        <p class="b36q__a">Participants will submit a working prototype, its architecture and an impact case. Detailed submission guidelines will be shared on the Hack2skill platform.</p>
      </details>

      <details class="b36q__item">
        <summary class="b36q__q"><span class="b36q__num" aria-hidden="true">07</span><span class="b36q__text">Is mentorship available?</span><span class="b36q__icon" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
        <p class="b36q__a">Yes. Participants will have access to structured mentoring with TiE charter members and technology architects.</p>
      </details>

      <details class="b36q__item">
        <summary class="b36q__q"><span class="b36q__num" aria-hidden="true">08</span><span class="b36q__text">What is the prize pool?</span><span class="b36q__icon" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
        <p class="b36q__a">The total cash prize pool is <strong>₹6,00,000</strong>, distributed among the top three teams: ₹3,00,000 for the Champion, ₹2,00,000 for the Runner-up and ₹1,00,000 for the Second Runner-up.</p>
      </details>

      <details class="b36q__item">
        <summary class="b36q__q"><span class="b36q__num" aria-hidden="true">09</span><span class="b36q__text">When is the submission deadline?</span><span class="b36q__icon" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
        <p class="b36q__a">The official submission deadline is yet to be announced. Please check the Hack2skill platform for updates.</p>
      </details>

      <details class="b36q__item">
        <summary class="b36q__q"><span class="b36q__num" aria-hidden="true">10</span><span class="b36q__text">Where will the Grand Finale take place?</span><span class="b36q__icon" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
        <p class="b36q__a">The in-person Grand Finale will take place at Brilliant Convention Centre, Indore, on <strong>14 December 2026</strong>.</p>
      </details>

      <details class="b36q__item">
        <summary class="b36q__q"><span class="b36q__num" aria-hidden="true">11</span><span class="b36q__text">Will participants retain ownership of their solutions?</span><span class="b36q__icon" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
        <p class="b36q__a">Yes. Participants retain ownership of the solutions they build.</p>
      </details>
